text_block_list.text:
One day, I step into my office and find
Biwa
Hayahide muttering to herself.
Hmm. This section looks fine...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'd still like to test the strength and
elasticity of
the fabric, though.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Of course, I can't forget to check how
the outfit
moves and looks while I'm on
stage...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ is examining her
signature
racewear closely and making
detailed notes of
her findings.

She already evaluated the outfit a while
ago when
it first arrived and tried it on,
but I suppose she
isn't done yet.
Oh. Hello there, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to ask for your opinion, but
do you
notice anything off about my
outfit?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You can be honest. I'm trying to identify
and
make note of any issues.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Well... yes.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You'll probably say I'm overthinking it,
but I just
can't relax until I've made sure
everything is
perfect.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I've encountered so many exceptional
athletes
since I entered Tracen
Academy.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
They're able to adapt quickly to
unexpected
circumstances and don't
hesitate to let go of the
old if the need
ever comes.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And they're capable of overcoming
challenges
with their extraordinary
strength.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: However, I lack such qualities.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I know it would benefit me to learn by
their
example, but I can't bring myself to
let go of the
things I've accumulated
over the years.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So the only thing I can do is prepare as
much as
possible in advance.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
However, this method may forever doom
me to
being no more than an ordinary
racer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Why don't you try stopping your note-taking
for a while?

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Can I take a look at your notes?

text_block_list.text: Sure, I don't mind.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm shocked by the overwhelming
volume of notes
that I find in her
notebook.

There are detailed analyses of every
track,
placement records, and strategies
on how to
improve her performance
before a race.

Everything Бива Хаяхидэ has learned
through
trial and error is meticulously
recorded.

What's wrong, Тренер? You're awfully
quiet...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The more one prepares for every
eventuality, the
more they're able to
perform at full potential.

However, not everyone has the ability to
do this.
I tell her that her attention to
detail and
analytical ability is what sets
her apart.

You have a point. That's certainly one
way to
look at it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Let's take full advantage of this secret power of
yours!

text_block_list.text:
I suppose if this weapon is unique only
to myself,
then there's no need to
compare myself to others,
is there?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I feel like a new path of
possibility
has been opened up to me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I've tried several times...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I've never been able to stay calm
without it. I
become so anxious that I
always end up with my
notebook in my
hands before I realize it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If I truly wanted to stop, I would require
enough
nerve to simply tear the whole
thing apart.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Essentially, it's true. I'd have to burn that
bridge,
so to speak.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: And perhaps...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I don't even need this anymore!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ moves to destroy her
notebook,
and in a panic I reach out to
stop her. Before I
can, however, her face
crumples.
I... I can't do it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I don't have it in me to compete against
such
strong opponents entirely
unprepared... I just
don't!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Seeing how stressed she is by this
ordeal, I start
to think that pushing her
to make such a radical
change might not
be the best approach.
Instead, I take a breath and say...
choice_data_list:
That's all right! There's no need to destroy your
notes!

text_block_list.text: But if I don't...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Don't worry. We can simply do what works for
you!

text_block_list.text:
I tell her there's nothing wrong with
taking
detailed notes on items of
concern—rather, they
can be a vital tool
for her growth.
I really don't need to get rid of them?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Maybe you're right... Maybe it's better to work with myself rather than against.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that has taken such a
weight off
my shoulders. Thank you so
much, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We spend time going over her notes,
discuss her
most recent areas of concern,
and brainstorm
ways to tackle them
together.

There's no magic equation for growth.
And that's
exactly why I'm eager to keep
learning through
trial and error with her
until we find what's right.
